question.problem:
Find the solution to the inequality $\frac{3-5z}{8}\le 6-2z.$

The solution is $z$
{{field-1}}{{field-2}}.
question.worked_solution:
First, we clear the rational expression by multiplying both sides by $8:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3-5z}{8} & \le 6-2z \\ 8\cdot (\frac{3-5z}{8}) & \le 8\cdot (6-2z) \\ \cancel{8}\cdot (\frac{3-5z}{\cancel{8}}) & \le 8\cdot (6-2z) \\ 3-5z & \le 48-16z\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we apply the addition and multiplication principles:

$$
\begin{aligned}3-5z & \le 48-16z \\ 3-5z+16z & \le 48-16z+16z \\ 3+11z & \le 48 \\ 3+11z-3 & \le 48-3 \\ 11z & \le 45 \\ \frac{11z}{11} & \le \frac{45}{11} \\ z & \le \frac{45}{11}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $z\le \frac{45}{11}.$
